summary: NatWest Group plc furnished a Form 6-K announcing publication of a Fifth Supplementary Prospectus dated 30 October 2026 to its £40,000,000,000 Euro Medium Term Note Programme established 5 December 2025. The FCA approved the document, which is available via the London Stock Exchange and the National Storage Mechanism. This is a routine debt-issuance disclosure under the programme, equivalent to a US shelf supplement for notes. No purchase price, stake, or corporate transaction is involved. What to watch: nothing for risk-arb; relevance is limited to EMTN programme funding and disclosure compliance.
